title: Airway Inflammation and remodeling in Asthma
abstract: Asthma is characterized by chronic airway inflammation mediated by Th2 cytokines including IL-4, IL-5, and IL-13. IgE binding to FceRI on mast cells triggers degranulation, releasing histamine and leukotrienes.

title: Beta-2 adrenergic receptor signaling in bronchial smooth muscle
abstract: Beta-2 adrenergic receptors (ADRbeta2) modulate smooth muscle relaxation. Bronchodilators targeting ADRbeta2 are standard rescue therapies, while inhaled corticosteroids target glucocorticoid receptors to suppress inflammation.
